enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the air conditioner set to a cool temperature for the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the legs. Turn the head to one side. Close the eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn the body onto the other side. Reach out one arm and press the pillow. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Roll onto the back. Stretch both legs. Remain lying still. Turn onto the side again. Push the blanket off with one foot. Reach the hand to the nightstand. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the button to lower the temperature. Put the remote back on the nightstand. Pull the blanket over the body. Remain lying in bed with the eyes closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, showering before the hot day begins
enriched_activities.desc: Open the eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing both legs to the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Press the light switch on. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the running water. Splash water onto the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the rack. Wipe the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Rub soap over the arms and torso. Rinse the soap off. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the body. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with plenty of water and fruit to stay hydrated
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the water bottle. Take out fruit. Take out bread and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate and a glass. Place them on the counter. Pick up the knife. Slice the fruit on the cutting board. Put the slices onto the plate. Pick up the kettle. Fill it with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Crack two eggs into a bowl. Pick up the fork. Beat the eggs. Place a pan on the induction cooker. Press the cooker switch on. Pour the eggs into the pan. Stir the eggs with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Pick up the plate. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork. Eat the eggs and fruit. Pick up the glass. Drink the water. Pour more water into the glass. Drink it. Stand up. Place the plate and glass in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes, packing a water bottle and light lunch for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a work shirt. Take out trousers. Lay the clothes on the bed. Take off the nightclothes. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Fasten the belt. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the water bottle from the desk. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lunch box. Place the lunch box into the bag. Close the refrigerator door. Place the water bottle into the bag. Pick up the bag. Walk to the hallway. Pick up the keys from the hook. Put the keys into the pocket. Pick up the phone. Put the phone into the pocket. Walk to the entrance door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility during the already rising morning heat
enriched_activities.desc: Open the entrance door. Step out. Pull the door closed. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Pull the key out. Put the key into the pocket. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk out of the building entrance. Open the bag. Take out the water bottle. Twist the cap open. Raise the bottle. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Put the bottle back into the bag. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Board the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Grasp the handrail. Stand in the aisle. Step off the bus at the stop. Walk to the health care facility entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties, taking hydration breaks in the air-conditioned ward
enriched_activities.desc: Walk through the facility entrance. Walk to the changing room. Take off the outer clothes. Put on the work uniform. Hang the bag in the locker. Close the locker. Walk to the ward. Pick up the patient chart. Read the notes. Walk to the patient bed. Greet the patient. Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the numbers on the display. Remove the cuff. Write the readings on the chart. Pick up the thermometer. Place it under the patient's tongue. Remove the thermometer. Read the temperature. Write it on the chart. Walk to the medication cart. Open the drawer. Take out the medication cups. Close the drawer. Carry the cups to the beds. Hand a cup to each patient. Pick up the water bottle. Twist the cap open. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Walk to the nurses' station. Sit down at the desk. Type the notes on the keyboard. Stand up. Walk to the next patient bed. Adjust the IV drip rate. Check the IV line. Replace the empty bag. Hang the new bag on the pole. Walk back to the nurses' station. Answer the phone. Speak to the caller. Put the phone down. Repeat the rounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the shift in the peak heatwave temperatures
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the locker. Open the locker. Take out the bag. Close the locker. Take off the work uniform. Put on the outer clothes. Walk out of the changing room. Walk to the facility exit. Step outside. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Open the bag. Take out the water bottle. Twist the cap open. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Put the bottle back into the bag. Board the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Grasp the handrail. Stand in the aisle. Step off the bus. Walk to the apartment building. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the apartment door. Take the key out of the pocket. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the door open. Step inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, keeping the range hood on and the kitchen ventilated
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Take out the water bottle. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a pan and a plate. Place them on the counter. Turn on the tap. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Put the pieces into a bowl. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the cooker switch on. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables. Stir with the spatula. Add the meat. Pour sauce into the pan. Press the range hood switch on. Stir the food. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the food onto the plate. Pick up the plate. Carry it to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Eat the food. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Stand up. Place the plate and fork in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and wiping down counters
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the empty plate from the table. Carry it to the sink. Pick up the empty glass. Carry it to the sink. Pick up the fork. Place it in the sink. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the upper rack. Place the plates in the rack. Place the glasses in the rack. Place the forks in the basket. Push the rack in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button on the dishwasher. Pick up the dishcloth from the hook. Turn on the tap. Wet the cloth. Turn off the tap. Wipe the counter surface. Wipe the table surface. Rinse the cloth. Hang the cloth back on the hook. Press the range hood switch off. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in the cooled living room, watching TV and rehydrating after the hot commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Press the light switch on. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote from the table. Press the power button on the remote. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the sofa armrest. Pick up the water bottle from the table. Twist the cap open. Raise the bottle. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Put the bottle back on the table. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Stand up. Walk to the refrigerator. Open the refrigerator door. Take out a cold bottle of water. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Twist the cap open. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Place the bottle on the table. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote. Press the power button off. Stand up. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and running the dehumidifier to keep the bathroom comfortable
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Press the light switch on. Press the dehumidifier power button on. Press the shower tap lever. Step into the shower. Stand under the water. Rub soap over the arms and legs. Rinse the soap off. Press the shower tap lever off. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the rack. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the bath mat. Lay the bath mat flat on the floor. Walk to the sink. Pick up the glass. Fill it with water from the tap. Drink the water. Place the glass on the shelf. Press the light switch off. Press the dehumidifier button to keep it running. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer at the desk for personal admin and reading, with the fan and air conditioner running
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the fan switch on. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button. Put the remote on the desk. Press the desk lamp switch on. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button on the laptop. Type on the keyboard. Move the mouse. Open the bank website. Type the login details. Click the payment button. Open an email. Type a reply. Press the send button. Close the browser window. Open the e-book file. Scroll through the pages with the mouse. Read the text on the screen. Take the water bottle from the desk. Twist the cap open. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Put the bottle on the desk. Scroll through more pages. Close the e-book file. Shut down the laptop. Close the lid. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime routine: washing up, brushing teeth and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Press the light switch on. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Pick up the glass. Fill it with water. Drink the water. Put the glass on the shelf. Press the light switch off. Press the dehumidifier power button off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in the air-conditioned bedroom to recover from the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Push the door closed. Walk to the bed. Pull the blanket back. Sit down on the bed. Lie down. Pull the blanket over the legs. Pick up the air conditioner remote from the nightstand. Press the button to set the temperature. Put the remote on the nightstand. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Turn the head to one side. Close the eyes. Turn the body onto the side. Reach out one arm and adjust the pillow. Pull the blanket up. Roll onto the back. Stretch both legs. Remain lying still with the eyes closed.
